description: Centralized thresholds for the inspection. 'high'/'low' rules are applied directly by the collection layer; 'params' rules hold the knobs for named adapters that keep sustained-window or correlation logic.

sql_duration_p99_ms.description: Query latency P99 series, peak (max) guardrail in ms.

sql_duration_p999_ms.description: Extreme-tail P999 series, peak (max) guardrail in ms.

rc_request_wait_s.description: Resource-control request wait peak. No NOTICE band (notice defaults to warning), matching the original two-band logic: <0.01 HEALTHY, 0.01-0.05 WARNING, >=0.05 CRITICAL.

tidb_cpu_pct.description: TiDB CPU against core quota; warn-only (no CRITICAL band).

tikv_cpu_sustained.description: TiKV CPU sustained-pressure rule (CPU_SUSTAIN_WARN_PCT over ROLLING_15M_POINTS). Logic lives in the tikv_thread_pool_pressure adapter.

tikv_memory_pct.description: TiKV RSS against memory limit (MEMORY_WARN_PCT / MEMORY_ERROR_PCT).

tikv_grpc.description: TiKV gRPC failure-count-over-30m and P99 warn thresholds (GRPC_FAIL_30M_WARN_THRESHOLD / GRPC_P99_WARN_SECONDS).

tikv_unified_read_pool.description: Unified Read Pool hotspot detection (UNIFIED_READ_HOT_PCT / UNIFIED_READ_PEER_LOW_PCT).

tikv_slow_score.description: TiKV slow score alert value (SLOW_SCORE_ALERT_VALUE); warn-only.

tikv_raft_log_lag_p99.description: Raft log lag P99 alert (RAFT_LOG_LAG_P99_ALERT); warn-only.

store_capacity_usage_pct.description: Physical store capacity usage and rise (STORE_USAGE_WARN_PCT); rise_warn_pct in knobs.

inf_iops_exceeded.description: Cloud-volume exceeded-IOPS rate warn threshold (IOPS_EXCEED_WARN_THRESHOLD); warn-only.

cdc_checkpoint_lag_s.description: TiCDC changefeed checkpoint/resolved-ts lag (seconds): healthy < 300s, warning 300-3600s, critical >= 3600s.

tikv_cpu_pct.description: TiKV storage-node CPU against core quota; warn-only coarse customer signal (deep sustained-high analysis delegated to o11y).

tikv_compaction_pending_peak.description: Pending-compaction-bytes peak (512 GiB), coarse customer signal; deep sustained analysis delegated to o11y.

restart_count.description: Component restart count over the window; warn-only coarse signal (any restart >=1 → WARNING).

cdc_checkpoint_lag_s.description: TiCDC changefeed checkpoint/resolved-ts lag (worse of the two); coarse customer signal (WARNING >=5m, CRITICAL >=1h). Deep lag-trend/root-cause delegated to o11y.
